author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Focus query toggling duplicates local raw-query editing logic instead of sharing the established reader route helper pattern.
findings.consequence: Future fixes to bare query-key handling, malformed percent-encoding, or fragment preservation must be applied in more than one place, which can make editor focus URLs diverge from reader dialog/query URL behavior.
findings.evidence: `withBareQueryKey` implements its own fragment split, raw query split, decoded-key filtering, and bare-key append. `app/lib/reader-routes.ts` already centralizes the same raw full-path query-key filtering pattern for reader dialog keys, and the main reader page has a similar focus helper.
findings.recommendation: Move the generic bare query-key toggle into `app/lib/reader-routes.ts` and have both editor and reader focus links call that shared helper, preserving raw segments and fragments through one implementation.
